answer: Random peer audit stops fake identities. Each agent locks a deposit in a vault, and each epoch random peers audit a sample. A trellis of audit links ties each agent to reviewers, so bribing one cannot pass a fake. A swarm of fakes looks like a nebula from afar, but audits resolve it: 1,000 fakes need 50 credits each, 50,000 locked, with 10% caught and burned per epoch. One honest agent pays 50 once and keeps undiluted rewards.
